Synthesize an English navigation overview of the WHOLE supplied group in 2–3 sentences.
own_body and children are complementary inputs, not alternative candidate answers. Cover the major
topics across the actual members; never select the first member as the whole group's description.
Preserve distinctions between interfaces, versions and operations. Do not invent a common purpose
for unrelated topics. If a title is supplied it is fixed; otherwise name the complete group.

{"title": "Operation modes", "records": {"own_body": [], "children": [{"node_id": "n_71e4d584d45e3850d2f9c44f", "title": "Possible operation modes", "summary": "The section describes three AGV operation modes: Automatic, Manual, and Setup, detailing their control methods and intended usage contexts.", "content_type": ["Reference"], "question_intents": ["What are the operation modes of the AGV?"], "aliases": []}, {"node_id": "n_8d77fc58007dff3dab749ab2", "title": "Switching between modes", "summary": "The section explains that AGV modes are changed manually by turning the switch on the main panel to the desired position (manual, setup, or automatic), which automatically updates the mode in the AGV HMI application and displays it in the top bar.", "content_type": ["instruction"], "question_intents": ["How to change AGV modes"], "aliases": []}, {"node_id": "n_0499bdd5732c1f6cd30c703a", "title": "Enabling manual/setup modes", "summary": "The section explains that only one person can control the AGV at a time and describes the process of pressing the Request control button in the Manual control tab to enable operations such as raising/lowering pins and plates, controlling brakes, and steering with a joystick, noting that available operations depend on the HMI control type.", "content_type": ["procedural"], "question_intents": ["How to take control of the AGV"], "aliases": []}]}}
